reasons.action: The caller explicitly requests that the man walks down the corridor, an actual performed behavior that overrides the source plate's static pose.
reasons.medium: The medium decision authorizes converting the live-action reference into claymation puppets, so the requested rendering medium governs.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested; the retained charcoal technical jacket comes from the reference identity requirements.
reasons.lighting: No instruction specifies the light, an illuminating source, its direction, or visible quality; corridor location and medium conversion do not replace reference lighting.
reasons.framing: No requested shot scale, viewpoint, camera composition, or camera movement is stated; the 16:9 canvas ratio alone does not govern framing.
reasons.palette: No explicit color grade, saturation, contrast, or tonal treatment is requested; the separate medium conversion does not itself set scene palette.
